Subject: Trouble accepting Coupa invite — keeps redirecting to login loop

Hi Priyom,

We received the invite to NovaGrain's supplier portal (Coupa) this morning, but every time we click the activation link we land on the Redwood login page and then get bounced back to the invite URL — it just loops. Tried in Chrome and Edge, same behavior. Also, our W-9 upload fails with a 403 and the upload modal shows a blank preview. I attached the W-9 and a small capture of the console (sso-logs-novagrain.txt) — hope that helps.

Can you check whether the invite token is valid or if there is a proxy / cookie issue on your side? We're blocked from submitting PO billing info and the procurement team needs the portal to process our first invoice.

Thanks,
Elena Martin
Vendor Ops | NovaGrain Foods

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick repro and the attachments, that helps.

Short answer: it looks like there's an intermediary header/URL rewrite hitting the invite flow and dropping the SSO relay information. I'm looping in Ben (infra) and Karthik (SSO) to validate. As a short-term workaround I can generate a one-time manual activation link that bypasses the normal redirect chain — it will be valid for 48 hours. Would you like me to send that now so your team can finish the W-9 upload and PO confirmation?

Next steps from our side:
- Ben to check edge/proxy logs on Redwood's ingress for any header-stripping rules.
- Karthik to validate the SAML/RelayState that Coupa received.

I'll send the manual link once Ben confirms there isn't a broader incident.

— Priyom
Senior Manager, Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-04T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Coupa invite — keeps redirecting to login loop

Hey team,

I pulled the edge logs for the time window Elena pasted. Observations:
- The invite click reaches our load balancer, but an intermediate proxy (user-agent: CorpProxy/2.4) rewrites outgoing Location headers and strips X-Forwarded-Proto and a custom header we use for RelayState. That would explain why Coupa's return flow doesn't include the token.
- The upload 403 appears to be AWS S3 pre-signed URL requests being downgraded to HTTP by the proxy which then fails S3 signature verification.

Action plan:
1) I'll add a bypass for coupa.redwood.com in the proxy allowlist and reissue the invite token (new expiry 48h).
2) Karthik, can you confirm the SAML RelayState will be honored if headers are preserved? If not we'll need an alternate PS: header-backed fallback.

Marissa FYI — this may affect the other vendor invites currently in flight; we should hold automated invites for 20 minutes while I push the proxy update.

— Ben
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

https://coupa.redwood.com/manual-accept?token=MANUAL-7f3a9c8b

Best,
